name: Atlantis The Royal

address.street: Crescent Rd - Palm Jumeirah - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Dubai's newest ultra-luxury icon rises like a modern-day wonder on the Palm Jumeirah, redefining what's possible in hospitality.
whats_special: This architectural marvel features the world's largest jellyfish aquarium, 17 celebrity chef restaurants including Nobu and Heston Blumenthal, and suites starting at 1,500 square feet. The resort's infinity pools seemingly float 90 meters above sea level, offering unparalleled views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's skyline.
pro_tip: Book dinner at Dinner by Heston Blumenthal for his famous "Meat Fruit" dish while watching the Dubai Fountain show across the water – the timing creates an unforgettable sensory experience.
dont_miss: The Cloud 22 sky pool experience and the resort's private beach with butler service. Take the complimentary monorail to explore Atlantis The Palm's Aquaventure Waterpark and Lost Chambers Aquarium, included with your stay.
pros: Ultra-luxury architectural masterpiece with iconic design and stunning Dubai skyline views
World-class celebrity chef restaurants including Nobu and José Andrés concepts
Exclusive access to Atlantis waterpark and aquarium with private beach and pools
Exceptional personalized service with dedicated butler and concierge teams
cons: High-energy resort atmosphere may not suit guests seeking tranquil retreat
